packageRules.description: Seven's pins: every @ai-ecoverse package in the base set (src/packages), the optional catalog's non-homescoop entries (src/packages/optional/package.json: slicc-jsh, mcpcat, wasi-slicc and sliccy-browser) and /opt/agent (src/packages/agent) bumps by itself, with its npm and pnpm lockfiles. The catalog's homescoop entries aren't pinned: seven offers each one's npm latest at runtime, behind the gate in src/seed/packages.js. The automerge goes through the merge queue once ci / test (with release-state for every gated pin, scripts/cert/release-state.mjs) and cert-review pass; no bot writes to the branch.
homescoop's packages (wasi-*, wasix-*, wasm-*, py-*, wasi-pnpm included) come as one PR a day, which cert review certifies package by package.

Python's packages move as one: every py-* of the Python data tools (src/packages/optional/projects/pydata) is a build for one Python ABI, the one the catalog's python range (src/packages/optional/catalog.json, the upstream X.Y.Z with homescoop's -N ignored) offers, and seven never mixes two Pythons' builds. bios takes them by hand, in one PR that also bumps the project's version so installs show Update and moves the catalog's python range when the ABI moves, so Renovate lists the group on the dependency dashboard and opens its one PR only when it is ticked there.
The agent is bumped by hand with the pins it needs (spectrum, vault, the genai override), so Renovate opens its PR but never merges it.
The kernel gets its own PR, the base set's and /opt/agent's pins together (pins.test wants them equal), not grouped with pnpm as the shared preset does.
Skipped: wasi-pnpm 12.9.1-11 and 12.9.1-12 are deprecated, since installs can fail with rename timeouts on OPFS (ai-ecoverse/homescoop#1128). Use 12.9.1-13 or later.
The grammars and Tailscale projects (src/packages/grammars, src/packages/tailscale) are pinned by hand: Renovate lists them on the dependency dashboard and opens a PR only when one is ticked there.
